description: This file defines an interface for managing product options within an e-commerce platform. It extends a generic entity service and declares methods for listing, retrieving by name or code, and saving or updating product options, with consideration for store and language contexts.

classes.name: ProductOptionService
classes.description: An interface extending generic service for product options, providing methods to list, retrieve, and save product options, tailored for store and language contexts.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of product options for a specific store and language, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves product options by store, name, and language, possibly throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product option or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listReadOnly
methods.description: Returns a read-only list of product options for the specified store and language, possibly throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a product option based on the store and option code.
